lesson_1.title: Max Finder
lesson_1.task: You are given an array of numbers. Your goal is to determine the highest value in the list by scanning each element one by one. Start by assuming the first element is the maximum, then compare it with every other element and update your maximum whenever you find a larger value. If the array is empty, immediately return 'Error' since there is nothing to evaluate. Ensure that all comparisons are done using a single pass through the array.

lesson_1.title: Min Finder
lesson_1.task: You are tasked with finding the smallest number in an array by examining each element sequentially. Begin by treating the first element as the minimum value, then iterate through the rest of the array comparing each element to your current minimum and updating it whenever a smaller value is found. If the array has no elements, return 'Error' immediately since no comparison can be made.

lesson_1.title: Sum Search
lesson_1.task: Given an array of integers, compute the total sum by iterating through each element one at a time and accumulating its value into a running total variable. Start the sum at zero and continuously add each element as you traverse the array. If the array is empty, simply return 0 since there are no values to add.

lesson_1.title: Count Evens
lesson_1.task: Scan through the array element by element and count how many numbers are even. A number is considered even if it is divisible by 2 without remainder. Maintain a counter that increases every time you encounter an even value. If no even numbers exist or the array is empty, return 0.

lesson_1.title: First Negative Finder
lesson_1.task: Traverse the array from left to right and identify the first element that is less than zero. As soon as you find a negative number, return it immediately without checking the rest of the array. If no negative numbers exist or the array is empty, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Target Search
lesson_2.task: Perform a sequential search through the array to locate the first occurrence of the target value. Compare each element one by one until you find a match, then return its index. If the target does not exist in the array or the array is empty, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Count Occurrences
lesson_2.task: Iterate through the array and count how many times a given value appears. Each time you encounter the target value, increment a counter. After finishing the traversal, return the total count. If the value does not appear or the array is empty, return 0.

lesson_2.title: Last Occurrence
lesson_2.task: Scan the entire array while tracking the most recent index where a given value appears. Each time the value is found, update a stored index. After completing the traversal, return the last recorded index. If the value is never found or the array is empty, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Search in Range
lesson_2.task: Search for a value within a specific index range of the array. Only examine elements from index a to index b inclusive. Return the first index where the value is found within this range. If the value does not exist in the range or the range is invalid, return -1.

lesson_2.title: Multi-Target Search
lesson_2.task: Check whether two given values exist anywhere in the array. Traverse the array once while tracking whether each target has been found. Return True only if both values are found at least once; otherwise return False. If the array is empty, return False.

lesson_3.title: Bubble Sort Ascending
lesson_3.task: Sort the array in ascending order using Bubble Sort. Repeatedly compare adjacent elements and swap them if they are in the wrong order. Continue passes through the array until it is fully sorted in increasing order.

lesson_3.title: Selection Sort Ascending
lesson_3.task: Sort the array in ascending order using Selection Sort. Repeatedly find the smallest element from the unsorted portion of the array and move it into its correct position in the sorted portion until the entire array is sorted.

lesson_3.title: Bubble Sort Descending
lesson_3.task: Sort the array in descending order using Bubble Sort. Repeatedly compare adjacent elements and swap them whenever the left element is smaller than the right element. Continue passes until the array is sorted from largest to smallest.

lesson_3.title: Selection Sort Descending
lesson_3.task: Sort the array in descending order using Selection Sort. Repeatedly select the largest remaining element from the unsorted portion and place it at the front of the sorted portion until the entire array is sorted in decreasing order.

lesson_3.title: Visual Sort Tracking
lesson_3.task: Simulate Bubble Sort passes on the array and count how many full passes are required before the array becomes fully sorted in ascending order. Return the total number of passes performed until completion.
